services.desc: A natural outdoor geothermal hot springs in the heart of the Valley of the Moon! BACK FOR 2026: Guaranteed access for all Season Passholders WITHOUT A RESERVATION (even after we have sold out of Day Passes for the day)! That’s right… we do not require any reservations at all for our Season Passholders!! As a Season Passholder, feel free to come anytime we are open and enjoy just pulling up to the gate without a reservation and we’ll check you in, even if Day Passes are sold out and as we continue to limit overall day passes so it’s never too crowded. All that we ask is… please have your valid Season Pass card handy to show us at every visit and please have patience with the gate to allow
